items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in North Sea.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 to 7, decreasing 4 or 5 later tonight, then 2 or 3 tomorrow morning. Becoming Variable early afternoon, East or Southeast 4 or 5 later in afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough, falling slight later tonight and tomorrow morning, Slight or moderate late afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or Southeast 4 or 5, increasing 6 to gale 8 later tomorrow evening and tomorrow night, then becoming Cyclonic 4 to 6 on Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather##

Rain developing.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
